احونصلت (form IIIq)
# اِحْوَنْصَلْتُ (iḥwanṣaltu) /iħ.wan.sˤal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# اِحْوَنْصَلْتَ (iḥwanṣalta) /iħ.wan.sˤal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# اِحْوَنْصَلْتِ (iḥwanṣalti) /iħ.wan.sˤal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# اِحْوَنْصَلَتْ (iḥwanṣalat)
